title: refactor(driver-sql): the durability gate and the compile-refusal enumeration read the sql-driver facade, so the codemod moves four more members (#30147 phase 2b)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWMEECkfNfe2VjW9rMJG3n7)_

Part of #30147 (phase 2b of 2a-2d: two by-path readers learn the facade form, so the codemod moves four more members. 2c, 2d and the phase 3 measurement stay open on the card.)

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:`check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 学会跨文件跟随 sql-driver 的 facade(facet 模块里的 `this.x()` 调到 `SqlDriver#x`,再穿过 stub 到 facet 方法体);`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` 改为读取全部 `sql-driver-*.ts` 模块。codemod 因此去掉 1 个 pin 和 4 个 needle,重新生成后又有 4 个成员变成委托,登记表 73 → 69。
- 为什么改:这两个读者只认 `sql-driver.ts` 本文件,codemod 只好把这些方法留在类上;读者学会新形态后,codemod 才能把它们移走(#30147,裁决 6597555122 第 3 条)。
- 风险与回滚:方法体逐字节不变(175/175),公开 `.d.ts` 与 base 相同;durability 门禁在 base 和 head 上读到同样的 52 个 seam、同样的判定,只有两个 seam 的位置从 `sql-driver.ts` 换到 `sql-driver-rotation.ts`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:门禁里新增的 `FACADE_LOG_HOP` / `createFacadeLogHop` 和 `collectLoggedLevels` 里的 6 行接入;测试里 `sources` 的改法。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs --self-test`(新增 10 行通过)和 `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 21510bba`(`175/175`,退出 0)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位审阅并落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Two readers took `sql-driver.ts` text by path, so the codemod pinned four members on the class. Each reader now reads the facade form, and the pins go.

**`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`.** Its catch side follows a log helper to its body by name, in the same file. A catch the codemod moves into a facet module calls `this.logDurabilityFailure(…)`, which that module does not declare. Once `logDurabilityFailure` itself moves, the method the call reaches is a one-call stub. Either way the catch read "swallowed, no log": with the pins removed and no reader change, the gate reds the two `runWideningAlters()` catches in `sql-driver-rotation.ts`. `FACADE_LOG_HOP` follows exactly the two shapes the codemod writes:

- HOST CALL: `this.x(…)` in a `sql-driver-*.ts` module, inside a function whose `this` is the module's own host interface (bare or through a `Pick` naming `x`), whose member `x` is typed `T['x']` with `T` the `SqlDriver` class imported from `./sql-driver.js` (directly or as `SqlDriverClass`), resolves to `SqlDriver#x` in `sql-driver.ts`. That is one hop, the same hop the call made before the move.
- STUB: a `SqlDriver` method whose last statement returns `<X>Facet.x.call(<y>Host.of(this), …)` is read as the facet's static `x`. This costs no depth.

Every other shape stays unresolved, as before. A log found across the hop is reported at the line of the call in the file being judged. The hop is handed in by `run()` to the log-level rule only. The read-seam rule's scan roots do not include `driver-sql`, so the two rules still agree on every file they both read.

**`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`.** The enumeration read five named files. It now reads every `sql-driver-*.ts` module in the directory. A facet's static `x` is named `SqlDriver.x`, because it is that method's body. The positive control also asserts that the five files it used to read, plus one facet module, are still among those it reads. The pinned sets are unchanged.

**Codemod (`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`).** These entries are gone:

- the `logDurabilityFailure` pin;
- the `this.runWideningAlters(` needle;
- the three `CLASS_PATH_READER_NEEDLES` rows (the table stays, empty, with its comment rewritten).

The tree is regenerated from `21510bba`, so `logDurabilityFailure`, `migrateMysqlDatetimeColumns`, `migrateMysqlTimeColumns` and `resolveWithheldFilterRefusal` move. `sql-driver.ts` goes from 10,717 to 10,624 lines.

**Registry.** The four rows are deleted, so 73 rows become 69.

| card | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| #30020 | 17 | 17 |
| #30054 | 16 | 16 |
| #30055 | 6 | 6 |
| #30147 | 34 | 30 (sql-driver.ts 12 → 8) |
| total | 73 | 69 |

## Tests

- The durability gate's self-test gains 10 rows, each driven through `analyzeSourceFile` the way `run()` drives it, over multi-file fixtures:
  - the hop reaches a loud body;
  - the same hop to a `warn` body is judged at that level;
  - with no hop the moved catch reads swallowed;
  - the same files in another directory, a member typed otherwise, a member the `Pick` omits and a class type imported from elsewhere each resolve nowhere;
  - a routed module's `SqlDriverClass` alias resolves;
  - a `sql-driver.ts` catch follows the stub;
  - a stub handing anything but `<y>Host.of(this)` is not followed.
  The `selfTest` partition floor goes 70 → 80 and the roster total 137 → 147.
- The compile-refusal test keeps its 115 cases. Reading the old five files over the new tree reds "only three functions build the envelope WITHOUT the seam". Measured before the widening.
- No other test file changes. The suites below ran at base `9b8a5867` and at head; the counts are equal.

| suite | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| driver-sql (`vitest run`) | 238 files passed, 12 skipped; 3,859 passed, 216 skipped | the same |
| driver-turso (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 97 files; 2,514 passed, 34 skipped | the same |
| driver-sqlite-wasm (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 40 files; 750 passed | the same |
| cli by-path pins (9 files) | 9 files; 116 passed | the same |
| types / metadata / metadata-protocol by-path tests, spec `check-liveness.test` | 53 / 11 / 33 / 74 passed | the same |

## Acceptance notes

- `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` is a by-path reader, not the facade gate. The facade gate script and its self-test are untouched.
- No changeset, as #30139 and #30249 (`skip-changeset`): no published behaviour or surface changes.

## Verification

Head `d3ca391c`, base `origin/main` `9b8a5867`.
